text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days have passed since the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross regrets provoking Super Creek with her unsportsmanlike remarks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, I learn that Tamamo Cross had ignited Super Creek's fervor by threatening to hurt me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hope that Super Creek is able to run her next race with a calm mind and peaceful heart.
